 Note: 
 1-2 good Blueprism , Automation Anywhere tool resources with 6m-1yr live project experience. 6 months to 1 Year Experience.
 Trained/experienced SSE/SE in Blueprism or Automation.
 Ready to travel 50-70%. 
 EST to CST time zone is suitable 
 Good team player and ready to learn new things
 

 Description: 
 Skill: .net

 5. Good Communication skills- Written and Verbal

 Must be able to pass a background and drug screen
